departments.hint: Agents see only tickets in their departments.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a person
inviteDialog.description: They get a link valid for 7 days. Roles are per brand; you can change them later.
inviteDialog.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
inviteDialog.viewerOff: The Viewer role is turned off for this install.

empty.heading: Nobody here yet
empty.body: Invite the first person to {{brand}} and they will appear here.
empty.noMatchesBody: Try part of a name or an email address.

roleDialog.title: Change role
roleDialog.description: {{name}} keeps their account; only what they may do in {{brand}} changes. Their open sessions end, so the new role takes effect at once.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.body: They are signed out everywhere, taken out of presence and round-robin, and stop receiving notifications. You can reactivate them later.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from {{brand}}?
remove.body: They lose their role in this brand and every session ends. Roles they hold in other brands are untouched.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation to {{email}}?
revoke.body: The link stops working. You can invite the same address again afterwards.

toast.resent: A new invitation is on its way to {{email}}.
toast.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed.
toast.selfChange: You cannot change your own role.
toast.lastInstallAdmin: This is the last install admin, so it cannot be deactivated.
toast.outOfScope: You can only manage agents and viewers in your own departments.
toast.viewerDisabled: The Viewer role is turned off for this install.
toast.secondFactorReset: {{name}}'s second factor was reset. They were signed out and will set one up at their next sign-in.
toast.lastBreakGlass: {{name}} is the last install admin who can sign in while SSO is enforced. Make another install admin ready to sign in with a password and a second factor first.
toast.resetRateLimited: Too many resets in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
toast.secondFactorChanged: {{name}}'s second factor changed while you were confirming. Open the menu again.

reset.stepUp: Use your passkey, or enter your password or a code from your authenticator app, to reset {{name}}'s second factor.
reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s second factor?
reset.consequence: {{name}} is signed out everywhere. At their next sign-in they set up a second factor again before they can use Helpdock. We email them about it.
reset.warning: Make sure {{name}} asked for this through a channel you trust. Whoever knows their password can set up the next second factor.
